about: Hitting (bat) hand of each OpenTTGames player by table side in the camera view. The dataset's labels give the table side of each stroke, not the hand, so every hand here was checked by a person. Pass these to eval/extract_strokes.py (--left-hand / --right-hand).

test_1.source: verified on frames, 2026-11-18: the left player faces the camera and raises the bat in the arm on the image's left (his right) on forehand loops; the right player is seen in profile facing the table, his near arm (left) hangs free with an open hand and the bat is in his far arm (right) on backhand blocks. The faster wrist at contact agrees (right 8/8 and 7/8); red rubber near the wrist pointed to the left hand for both (red banner lettering behind them), so it is not used here.

test_3.source: verified on frames, 2026-11-17 (stored with the cached pose windows)

test_5.source: the user watched the whole video, 2026-11-18: both players are left-handed (confirmed ground truth; it overrides the earlier frame guess that the left player looked right-handed)
